Name: No Secret Woods Slimes
Author: sskerye
Description:
[size=5][b]No Secret Woods Slimes (秘密森林无史莱姆)[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]

Stops slimes from naturally spawning in the Secret Woods each day. Gather your daily hardwood in peace — no more dodging slime ambushes between the stumps.

[size=4][b]Details[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Only affects the Secret Woods. Slimes everywhere else in the valley spawn exactly as usual.[/*]
[*]Prevents the daily slime respawn. Slimes already lurking in the woods stay until you clear them out — after that, they won't come back.[/*]
[*]Everything else in the woods is untouched: the six hardwood stumps keep regrowing every day, and forage and other spawns behave as in vanilla.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

Only the host needs to install this mod. Farmhands can join with or without it.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size]

Safe to remove at any time. Daily slime spawns in the Secret Woods will resume from the next day, as in vanilla.

[line]

[size=5][b]秘密森林无史莱姆 (No Secret Woods Slimes)[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]模组功能[/b][/size]

阻止秘密森林每天自然生成史莱姆。安心采收每日硬木——再也不用在树桩之间躲避史莱姆的伏击。

[size=4][b]详细说明[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]只影响秘密森林。山谷其他地方的史莱姆照常生成，完全不受影响。[/*]
[*]阻止的是每日自然刷新。森林里已有的史莱姆会留在原地，直到你清理干净——之后它们不会再回来。[/*]
[*]森林里的其他内容一切照旧：六个硬木树桩照常每天再生，采集品和其他生成都与原版一致。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]多人游戏[/b][/size]

只需房主安装本模组。其他玩家装不装都可以正常加入。

[size=4][b]前置要求[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]星露谷物语 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 或更高版本[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]安装方法[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]将模组文件夹解压到游戏的 Stardew Valley/Mods 目录。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]卸载说明[/b][/size]

随时可安全卸载。卸载后从第二天起，秘密森林的史莱姆会恢复原版每日生成。
